title: Reconcile the swarming reference with the one dispatch door
action: Slice 2, the documentation half of D12's carrier. Today the swarming reference tells an agent to name subagent_type bee-extract for the extraction tier (swarming-reference.md:104-114 and :294) while AGENTS.md forbids hand-picking subagent_type and the one door lists only four kinds — an agent obeying both cannot dispatch a read-only worker at all. Decision 8dad7c2e names resolving this contradiction as one of its consequences. Once mrs-5 makes every rendered agent returnable through the door, rewrite these lines so the door is the only spelling and the agent names appear solely as what prepare RETURNS. Do NOT hand-edit the four mirror trees under .claude/, .codex-plugin/, .opencode/ and .claude-plugin/: skills/ is the source and the mirrors are rendered, differing from it by intended runtime-conditional blocks. Run the regen chain inside this cell — bee dev regen (render-skill-trees, then onboard --repo-root . --apply, then release-manifest --write, in that order) — and let it write them. PROOF NOTE: the mirrors are NOT byte-identical to skills/ — three files differ by design — so the proof is that regen runs clean, release-manifest --check passes, and each tree matches its own render; never a byte-identity diff.
verify: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml devtools && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

truths: No shipped instruction tells an agent to hand-pick a subagent_type
The read-only worker is dispatchable by following the docs alone, with no contradiction against AGENTS.md
The four mirror trees are written by the regen chain, not by hand, and bee dev release-manifest --check passes
